notes: The second *of* is given to the coordinated rectum כֵּפִים under rule 19 rather than read as a distributed repetition of the first (rule 25); each rectum bears its own relation to the construct.
*In* before *holes* answers to no preposition morpheme and is placed on the noun under rule 33.
*So that* is the purpose לְ's complementizer under rule 52, the infinitive keeping its supplied subject and verb.
